studio.stageMessage.analyze: Start the ANALYSIS stage. Read import/_analysis/THEME.md and theme-digest.json, then open the source files they reference for the top components. Write DESIGN_BRIEF.md at the workspace root with: the color palette (exact hex values from the digest) mapped to semantic roles, typography (families, scale, weights), shape language (radii, shadows, spacing base) and the component inventory to build (digest candidates merged with the standard roadmap). Summarize the brief in chat and WAIT for my confirmation — do not touch tokens.css or any component yet. If import/ does not exist, interview me about direction (references, tone, colors), write the brief from my answers and likewise WAIT for my confirmation before submitting.
studio.stageMessage.tokens: Start the TOKENS stage. Following DESIGN_BRIEF.md and the digest, rewrite pkg/src/tokens.css completely with semantic CSS variables (--color-*, --font-*, --radius-*, --space-*, --shadow-*) using the theme's real measured values — never invent colors. Make sure the gallery tokens page renders every token, then open the preview, take a screenshot and check the console; fix every issue before finishing. End with a summary table comparing the final palette to the digest values.
studio.stageMessage.primitives: Work on the PRIMITIVES stage. Check ds_list_components and pick the next ~5 primitive components from the brief inventory that are not registered yet. For EACH one: implement every variant/size backed by the digest evidence, style hover/focus-visible/active/disabled states, add basic ARIA, consume tokens only (zero raw hex/px literals), add a gallery demo rendering every variant, verify with a screenshot and a clean console, then call ds_record_component immediately. Finish by listing what was built and which primitives remain.
studio.stageMessage.composites: Work on the COMPOSITES stage. Check ds_list_components and pick the next ~5 composite components from the brief inventory that are not registered yet. Compose them FROM the existing primitives — never fork their styles. For EACH one: every variant/state, basic ARIA, tokens only, gallery demo with every variant, screenshot + clean console, then ds_record_component immediately. Finish by listing what was built and which composites remain.
studio.stageMessage.docs: Run the DOCS & REGISTRY stage. Run ds_list_components and register any approved gallery component still missing. Then rewrite pkg/docs.md completely: intro with install/usage, token tables, and one section per component (props, variants, accessibility notes, one usage example). Verify every registered component has an up-to-date gallery demo. Report the final coverage: components registered, demos present, docs sections written.
studio.stageMessage.templates: Work on the TEMPLATES stage. Build page-template components from the roadmap: in fidelity mode replicate each theme page 1:1 (structure and spacing from the referenced source HTML, colors via tokens); in creative mode reinterpret 3-5 key pages demonstrating the system in real context. For EACH one: compose existing components, add a gallery demo, verify with screenshot and clean console, then call ds_record_component with kind 'page-template' immediately. Finish by listing what remains.
